title: Lemonade external backend recipe manifest (v1)
description: Declarative manifest for an out-of-tree inference backend. The manifest schema version is the recipe's api_contract_version. lemond accepts manifests at or below its supported major and rejects unknown fields, unknown capability names, and unknown token names rather than ignoring them. Process confinement, ambient-environment scrubbing, and the sandbox grant block are owned by the companion Backend Sandbox RFC, not by this schema. Unknown fields are rejected at every object level; the sole open seams are `recipe_options` and `extensions`.

recipe.description: Stable recipe id. Must not collide with a built-in recipe; a collision is rejected at discovery.

api_contract_version.description: Manifest contract major, equal to the schema major. lemond rejects a value above its supported major with a clear message rather than a generic schema error, and never partially honors it.

extends.description: Recipe id whose declarative recipe_options this manifest inherits and may override. Declarative inheritance only; execution comes from this manifest or from variant_of. Mutually exclusive with variant_of. A cycle is rejected.

variant_of.description: Built-in recipe whose argv construction this manifest reuses against an external binary. Mutually exclusive with extends. The referenced recipe must be a built-in backend.

capabilities.description: Capabilities this backend serves. Each maps to one deployment mode and one or more fixed Lemonade routes; a manifest never opens a route. An operation outside this set is answered with the existing unsupported_operation envelope.

capability_enable_args.description: Extra argv appended when the capability's deployment mode is the one the model is loaded in. A model deploys in exactly one mode, so every declared capability of that mode is enabled together. Keys must be declared capabilities.

requested_ports.description: v1 defines the single-port contract. Multi-port is a reserved extension and a value above 1 is rejected.

reserved_args.description: Flags a user's {custom_args} must not supply. Enforced for an exact token or a leading '<flag>='; the check is exact and case-sensitive. Per-block reserved_args are unioned with these, with the block taking precedence.

model_management.description: self_managed means lemond does not pre-download model weights for this recipe. The readiness/model-inventory handshake is deferred by this RFC and is not implied by this flag.

default_accelerator.description: Accelerator key chosen when the request names no device. If absent, lemond selects by runtime detection (rocm/cuda/vulkan/oneapi/tpu) and falls back to cpu.

recipe_options.description: Declarative recipe options, inherited and overridable via extends, and resolvable as {custom:NAME} tokens. Open by design: keys are option names, values may be string, number, boolean, or array.

source.description: version-pinned binary source over HTTPS. The CLI fetches it and verifies sha256; lemond never downloads executables. variant_of only.

sha256.description: Content hash of the fetched artifact. Required for a variant_of unless version_policy is roll_forward.

version_policy.description: pinned (default) requires sha256; roll_forward is an explicit opt-out for authors tracking a moving artifact. variant_of only.

endpoints.description: Extension: remaps a declared capability's nonstandard engine path onto Lemonade's fixed route. Never opens a route; the value is an engine-side path, not a Lemonade endpoint.

downsize_endpoint.description: Extension: engine-side path invoked on soft-idle downsize.

extensions.description: Open, additive extension bag for experimental or future keys. It is the only forward-compatible seam within major 1; a new first-class field, capability name, or token still requires a new major.

binary.description: variant_of only: bare executable name inside the fetched artifact. No path separators or traversal.
